title: agassizia cheiranthifolia
intro: Agassizia cheiranthifolia, commonly known as Nihon-sou, is a type of seaweed found in the Pacific Ocean. This brown alga has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include lowering blood pressure and cholesterol levels, as well as reducing inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Agassizia cheiranthifolia are attributed to its anti-hypertensive, anti-cholesterolemic, and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include fucoidan, laminarin, and other polysaccharides, which have been shown to have antioxidant and immunomodulatory activities.
